decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used for the external surfaces of the extensions hereby approved shall only match those used on the existing buildings.
Condition : 3 - The short north elevation of the party wall shared with No.78, The Gardens shall be finished in the same manner and materials as the other elevations of the extension hereby approved.
Condition : 4 - The glazing in the external door and window in the side wall of the extension facing No.82 The Gardens, shall be in obscure glass only.

Condition : 5 - No additional door or window openings shall be provided in the external walls of the extension to the house hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - The roof area of the rear extension to the house shall not be altered or adapted for use as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension to the house and a single storey rear extension to the detached rear outbuilding
